verdict.rationale: As a chip, the M5 is programmable through documented public Apple APIs: Metal 4 Tensor APIs program the Neural Accelerators directly, and Core ML, Metal Performance Shaders, MLX and Foundation Models expose its AI hardware to developers. This is low-level, platform-locked hardware programming rather than an agent-friendly control API, and a community comment calls Apple's libraries insular. missing for 10: an agent-oriented or machine-readable API surface (developer.apple.com/llms.txt returns 404), M5-specific API reference depth beyond newsroom claims, independent hands-on corroboration of driving the Neural Accelerators via Metal 4.
